additional_info.subject: RE: ID0471316-DC/Si-D/MC-[Y2 / R9 313202799015] Communication issue CRM:03056000910
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0471316
﻿from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer: SMEG
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / R9 313202799015
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
On 19.01.2025 I aligned with Francois in regards of this ticket. Customer SMEG is experiencing issues with the connectivity of their XF4 routers.
In particular, it seems that:
The signal with certain network operators is low
Sometimes the SIM card is not detected, and the customer needs to send a technician to "clean" the SIM card
The SIM card is switching several times between different operators.
There are no issues on router XF3, provided with Siemens Vodafone Sim card.
The customer also sent us the data from the SIM card. I cannot take any information from this excel file, but to notice that the SIM card is switching between operators.
Please support the customer by pushing on a resolution form their side. What we recommend is:
​​​​​​​Change SIM card operator. It seems the SIM card they are using is not providing a great service. According to the SIM card data, it seems that the most used network operator in this location is: Bouygues Telecom
Have the customer analyze the SIM card data from their own sim card provider
Try to set an automatic reboot of the router from the Teltonika WebUI. This might bring improvements in the connectivity, but it is helpful mostly for single network operator sim cards.
If the connectivity with a new SIM car does not improve, you could make a rework on the charger and connected XF4 wired via XF3.
As agreed with Francois, I am moving this case to the RC-FR queue.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com
Important notice: This e-mail and any attachment thereof contain corporate proprietary information. If you have received it by mistake, please notify us immediately by reply e-mail and delete this e-mail and its attachments from your system.
Thank you.
